summary.name: BrainSoup
summary.one_liner: BrainSoup is a native Windows desktop application for building custom AI agents that work together and are controlled through natural language.
keywords: run ai on my own computer
use_cases: build specialized AI agents for business tasks
automate routine workflows with natural language
run local LLMs privately on a desktop
let AI agents work on files and scripts on a PC
answer questions from your own documents
summary.what_it_does: BrainSoup lets users create custom AI agents, each for a specific purpose, and have them collaborate in goal-oriented chat rooms. Agents are directed through conversation and can use built-in tools such as calculation, web browsing, email, API calls, image and video generation, and script execution, plus custom tools that run programs or scripts on the computer. Users can ground agents in their own documents and supports multimodal input (images and audio). Data is stored in a local database, and it can use cloud LLMs like ChatGPT and Mistral AI or local models via Ollama.
notable: Specialized agents collaborate in goal-oriented chat rooms, each with its own skills and data access
Local database and local LLM support via Ollama, with third-party requests anonymized
Built-in expert agent Doc-E helps set up automations and write extension scripts
Sandboxed file system for safe agent file access
caveats: Native app is Windows only; macOS, Android and iOS are listed only as planned future platforms
Roadmap items such as a command-line interface, headless server version, and optional cloud sync are listed as future plans, not current features
Pricing is not stated on the page
